name: baseline
note: All three roles on deepseek/deepseek-chat. Kept as the control -- newer variants below are measured against this one. See README.md's key-results table for the current legacy+medium A/B numbers (2026-08-17).

name: long-cheap
note: 2026-08-17 script-length feasibility A/B, arm 1. All six roles on deepseek-v4-flash-0731 pinned to OpenRouter's Decart endpoint (see eval/model_prices.json: ~4-8x cheaper than deepseek-chat's default routing). Real run (n=5, --pipeline-mode legacy --script-length medium): 5/5 succeeded, ~2x baseline's events per script at a LOWER cost per run ($0.0081 vs baseline's $0.0137) -- see README.md's key-results table. IMPORTANT: --pipeline-mode layered crashes unhandled on this Decart endpoint (crewai's beta.chat.completions.parse() gets a response with choices=None on the extractor's structured-output call) -- use --pipeline-mode legacy with this variant until that's fixed upstream or the endpoint changes. Set LLM_PROVIDER_ONLY=Decart to actually route there.

name: long-prose
note: 2026-08-17 script-length feasibility A/B, arm 2. Mechanical roles (extractor/beat_expander/writer/proof) on deepseek-v4-flash-0731 (Decart), dialogue/scene_writer on z-ai/glm-5.2 (Novita) for prose quality. Real run (n=5, --pipeline-mode legacy --script-length medium): 5/5 succeeded, longest average dialogue line (avg_line_chars=55.2 vs baseline's 19.3 and long-cheap's 43.0) and the most 武俠-flavored prose on a manual read -- see README.md's key-results table. Same --pipeline-mode layered caveat as long-cheap applies (shares its Decart-routed mechanical roles) -- use --pipeline-mode legacy. glm-5.2's Novita price is volatile; re-run scripts/refresh_prices.py --model z-ai/glm-5.2 --provider Novita before trusting a cost comparison involving this variant.

name: long-mimo
note: 2026-08-17 script-length feasibility A/B, arm 3. All six roles on xiaomi/mimo-v2.5 pinned to OpenRouter's GMICloud endpoint -- a Chinese-native model at a similar price point to deepseek-v4-flash-0731. Real run (n=2, --pipeline-mode legacy --script-length medium): only 1/2 succeeded -- one run failed with the same choices=None response the layered pipeline also hits on this endpoint (transient, not deterministic: a same-requirement legacy retry later succeeded), and the other failed a schema validation (model emitted a hallucinated 'bbox_id' field instead of 'npc_id'). Roughly 3x baseline's cost per run when it does succeed ($0.0244). Not currently recommended -- unreliable and expensive relative to long-cheap/long-prose; revisit if GMICloud's endpoint stabilizes.
